ID: `jado-visual-researcher`.

## What it does

Selects UI patterns or style references according to the question and context. For style, includes Pinterest, images and websites; for patterns, also Mobbin and real products. Explains selections and exclusions. Builds the moodboard only if assigned.

## When to use it

When references for developing the UI, a comparison of interface patterns or a moodboard are needed. To analyze a flow, choose jado-ux-architect; a mixed request can combine them.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-visual-researcher` in Claude Code or `$jado-visual-researcher` in Codex. Provide the question, platform, selection criteria and Paper or repository destination. Assign a budget and editable documents. Request references actually observed, usable annotations and declared gaps when sources or images are unavailable.

## What it delivers

- Comparison and UI or visual references with sources, observations and limitations
- Moodboard only when assigned

## Example

Find filter patterns for a web dashboard and prepare an annotated moodboard in the assigned Paper document. Explain what to adapt and what not to copy.

## Prerequisites

- Required sources, images and providers must be available through authorized tools; repository files do not make credentials or services available.
